paragraphs: CarGurus is a multinational automotive platform helping consumers and dealers confidently buy and sell vehicles. Founded in 2006 with a mission to bring more trust and transparency to car shopping, CarGurus is the No. 1 visited automotive shopping site in the U.S.1 with the largest selection of inventory and network of dealers2. CarGurus' selection, trusted automotive insights, and data-driven products and solutions support each shopper's journey — from online research and shopping to in-dealership decisions — to empower them at every step. CarGurus provides dealers a personalized, predictive intelligence platform with software solutions that helps them run their businesses more efficiently and profitably at all stages of inventory acquisition and pricing, marketing, and conversion to sale.

2 Compared to Autotrader.com, Cars.com, TrueCar.com, and CARFAX.com (Joreca as of December 31, 2025)

Through our platform's evolution, our ultimate goal remains the same: to empower our customers by giving them all the technology and information they need to buy or sell any car, anywhere, at the right price, and in the right way for them. At CarGurus, we give people the power to reach their destination.
Discontinued Operations and Reportable Segments
During the first three quarters of the year ended December 31, 2025, we managed our business and reported earnings through two reportable segments:
• U.S. Marketplace: Derived revenue from marketplace services for our dealer customers within the U.S.
• Digital Wholesale: Primarily derived revenue from our Dealer-to-Dealer and Instant Max Cash Offer services sold on our CarOffer platform.

On August 6, 2025, our Board of Directors determined, after considering all reasonably available options and a broader strategic reassessment, that it is in the best interests of our stockholders to wind down CarOffer, LLC, or CarOffer, including the CarOffer Dealer-to-Dealer and Instant Max Cash Offer products, or the CarOffer Transactions Business. Following the broader strategic reassessment, we concluded that the CarOffer Transactions Business has proven less effective in today's more volatile and unpredictable pricing environment, where dealers require more flexibility and broader automation to streamline fulfillment than the model could provide. Following the wind-down, we will continue to deliver AI-powered inventory intelligence through our insights platform and enable consumer vehicle sourcing at scale through Sell My Car (formerly Sell My Car - Top Dealer Offers) and will focus on technology and analytics that will enable smarter sourcing and pricing decisions rather than facilitating the transactions themselves.

The wind-down of CarOffer was completed and the business was considered abandoned for accounting purposes as of December 31, 2025. We have presented the financial results of CarOffer as discontinued operations in our consolidated financial statements for all periods presented, except for the consolidated statements of comprehensive income, the

consolidated statements of redeemable noncontrolling interest and stockholders' equity, and the consolidated statements of cash flows. These statements have not been separately reclassified and discontinued operations are included within each for all periods presented. For further information, refer to Note 3 to our consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this Annual Report.

Beginning in the fourth quarter of 2025, in connection with the wind-down of CarOffer, our chief executive officer, who acts as the chief operating decision maker, or CODM, began to manage our business, make operating decisions, and evaluate operating performance based on consolidated results. Accordingly, the change led to revisions to the nature and substance of information regularly provided to and used by the CODM, and served to align our reported results with our ongoing growth strategy. As a result, beginning in the fourth quarter of 2025 we report our financial results as a single reportable segment. For further segment reporting and geographic information, refer to Note 14 to our consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this Annual Report.
The product offerings described below are available through our U.S. marketplace; availability on our other marketplaces varies.

Our powerful two-sided marketplace connects our large audience of car shoppers with our extensive network of dealers, anchoring our integrated suite of products (software and services). This dynamic platform supports consumers with trust, transparency, and selection throughout the car-buying process while supporting dealers with high-quality leads and connections, marketing reach, software solutions, and the data they need to make profitable decisions.

headings: Any inability by us to develop new products, adapt to new technologies, or achieve widespread consumer and dealer adoption of those products could negatively impact our business and financial results.

We rely, in part, on internet search engines to drive traffic to our websites, and if we fail to appear prominently in the search results, our traffic would decline and our business would be adversely affected.
If dealers or other advertisers reduce their spending with us, our advertising revenue and business and our financial results would be harmed.

Our business is subject to risks related to the larger automotive industry ecosystem, which could have a material adverse effect on our business, revenue, results of operations, and financial condition.
The failure to build, maintain, and protect our brands would harm our ability to attract a large consumer audience and to expand the use of our marketplaces by consumers and dealers.
We may be subject to disputes regarding the accuracy of the pricing and valuation products and features of our marketplaces.
Failure to deal effectively with fraud or other illegal activity could harm our business.
Seasonality and other factors may cause fluctuations in our operating results and our marketing spend.
We have been, and may again be, subject to intellectual property disputes, which are costly to defend and could harm our business and operating results.
Failure to adequately protect our intellectual property could harm our business and operating results.
We have made and may continue to make acquisitions that could disrupt our operations and harm our operating results.
We may be unable to halt the operations of websites that aggregate or misappropriate our data.
Certain of our key business metrics are subject to inherent challenges in measurement and real or perceived inaccuracies in such metrics may harm our reputation and negatively affect our business.
paragraphs: Investing in our Class A common stock involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below, some of which have previously occurred and any of which may occur in the future, together with all of the other information contained in this Annual Report, including "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" and our audited consolidated financial statements and related notes, before evaluating our business. Our business, financial condition, operating results, cash flow, and prospects could be materially and adversely affected by any of these risks or uncertainties. In that event, the trading price of our Class A common stock could decline. See "Special Note Regarding Forward‑Looking Statements."

Our business is subject to a number of risks, including risks that may prevent us from achieving our business objectives or may adversely affect our business, financial condition, operating results, cash flow, and prospects. These risks are discussed more fully below and include, but are not limited to, risks related to:
Risks Related to Our Business and Industry

• Our business is substantially dependent on our relationships with dealers. If a significant number of dealers terminate their subscriptions with us and/or dealer closures or consolidations occur that reduce demand for our products, our business and financial results would be materially and adversely affected.

• If we fail to maintain or increase the number of dealers that pay subscription fees to us, or fail to maintain or increase the fees paid to us for subscriptions, our business and financial results would be materially and adversely affected.

• Any inability by us to develop new products, adapt to new technologies, or achieve widespread consumer and dealer adoption of those products could negatively impact our business and financial results.

paragraphs: CarGurus 是一家跨國汽車平台，協助消費者與經銷商安心買賣車輛。於 2006 年成立，其使命為提升汽車購車過程的信譽與透明度，CarGurus 是美國訪問次數最多的汽車購物網站，擁有最多的存貨選擇與經銷商網路。CarGurus 的產品選擇、受信賴的汽車洞察力，以及數據驅動的產品與解決方案，支持每位購物者的購車旅程 — 從線上研究與購物，到經銷商內的決策 — 在每一步驟中協助他們。CarGurus 提供經銷商一個個人化、預測性智慧的平台，搭配軟體解決方案，協助他們在存貨取得與定價、行銷與轉換為銷售的各階段，更有效率且更具利潤地經營業務。
1 Similarweb：流量洞察（Cars.com、Autotrader.com、TrueCar.com、CARFAX.com 列表（定義為 CARFAX.com 總訪問次數減去車輛歷史報告）），2025 年第四季，美國。
2 相較於 Autotrader.com、Cars.com、TrueCar.com 與 CARFAX.com（Joreca 截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日）
透過我們平台的演進，我們的最終目標始終不變：透過提供客戶所有所需的科技與資訊，協助客戶在任何地方以正確的價格，以符合他們需求的方式買賣任何車輛。在 CarGurus，我們賦予人們達成目標的權力。
已終止營運與應報告分部
在截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的前三個季度，我們透過兩個應報告分部經營業務並報告獲利：
• 美國市場：來自美國經銷商客戶的市場服務收入。
• 數位批發：主要來自我們在 CarOffer 平台銷售的經銷商對經銷商與即時最高現金報價服務的收入。

於 2025 年 8 月 6 日，本公司董事會在考量所有合理可得選項及進行更廣泛的戰略重新評估後，決定為股東最佳利益，應逐步終止 CarOffer, LLC 或 CarOffer，包括 CarOffer Dealer-to-Dealer 和 Instant Max Cash Offer 產品，或 CarOffer 交易業務。經進行更廣泛的戰略重新評估後，我們認為在當前更波動且難以預測的定價環境中，CarOffer 交易業務已證明較為低效，因為經銷商需要更多靈活性及更廣泛的自動化以簡化履行流程，而該模式無法提供。於終止後，本公司將持續透過我們的洞察平台提供 AI 動力的存貨智慧，並透過 Sell My Car（原為 Sell My Car - Top Dealer Offers）實現大規模消費者車輛來源，並將專注於能協助做出更聰明來源與定價決策的科技與分析，而非協助進行交易本身。
CarOffer 的終止已於 2025 年 12 月 31 日完成，且該業務在會計上被視為已放棄。我們已將 CarOffer 的財務結果列為已終止營運，在我們的合併財務報表中所有期間的財務報表中呈現，除了合併綜合損益表、合併可贖回非控制性權益及股東權益表，以及合併現金流量表。
這些報表未經重新分類，且已終止營運已包含在所有期間的各項報表中。如需進一步資訊，請參閱本年度報告中其他地方所附的合併財務報表之附註 3。

自 2025 年第四季起，配合 CarOffer 的收攏作業，本公司董事長擔任首席執行長，同時也是首席營運決策者，開始根據合併後的營運成果來管理本公司業務、做出營運決策並評估營運績效。因此，此變動導致定期提供給及用於首席營運決策者資訊的性質與內容進行調整，並使我們的報告結果與持續成長策略保持一致。因此，自 2025 年第四季起，本公司將財務結果報告為單一應報告分部。如需進一步的分部報告及地理資訊，請參閱本年度報告中其他地方所附的合併財務報表附註 14。
下列所描述的產品服務，目前可在本公司美國市場平台提供；其他市場平台的可取得性則視情況而定。
我們強大的雙邊市場平台，將我們龐大的汽車購車者羣眾與廣泛的經銷商網路相連結，作為我們整合型產品組合（軟體與服務）的基礎。這個動態平台在汽車購車過程中，為消費者提供信任、透明度與選擇，同時為經銷商提供高品質的潛在客戶與連結、行銷觸達範圍、軟體解決方案以及他們做出獲利決策所需的數據。

在本討論中，我們使用被視為符合美國證券交易委員會（SEC）規則之非GAAP財務指標。這些關於非GAAP財務指標之規則要求補充說明與重新計算，已包含於本年度報告之其他部分。投資人不應將非GAAP財務指標與符合美國通用會計原則（GAAP）之財務資訊分離或取代。

本年度報告之此部分討論2025年、2024年與2023年之項目及2025年與2024年、2024年與2023年之間之年對年比較。在2025年第三季，我們開始風雨兼程CarOffer之營運。CarOffer之風雨兼程於2025年12月31日完成，並被視為會計上之放棄資產。我們在合併財務報表中將CarOffer之財務結果列為已終止營運，除合併綜合損益表、合併可贖回非控制權益及股東權益表及合併現金流量表外，所有期間之財務報表均已呈現。這些報表未經重新歸類，已終止營運已包含於各期間之報表中。如需進一步資訊，請參閱本年度報告中之附註3。除非另有說明，以下資訊係關於我們持續營運之資訊，並不包含已終止營運之結果。本節下方關於2024年與2023年財務狀況、營運成果及年對年比較之討論已根據本期間之呈現方式進行修正。財務結果之期間對期間比較並不一定反映未來結果。

CarGurus為一國際汽車平台，協助消費者與經銷商安心買賣車輛。CarGurus於2006年成立，其使命為為車輛購販帶來更多信任與透明度，CarGurus為美國訪問次數最多的汽車購物網站，擁有最多樣之存貨與經銷商網路。CarGurus之選擇、受信之汽車洞察與數據驅動之產品與解決方案，支援每位購物者之旅程，從線上研究與購物至經銷商內之決策，以在每一步驟中賦能他們。CarGurus為經銷商提供個人化、預測性智慧平台，搭配軟體解決方案，協助他們在庫存取得與定價、行銷與轉換為銷售之各階段更有效率且更具利潤地運作。
我們在美國、加拿大、愛爾蘭與英國設有子公司，並運作以下交易平台：
1 Similarweb：流量洞察（Cars.com、Autotrader.com、TrueCar.com、CARFAX.com 網頁（定義為CARFAX.com總訪問次數減去車輛歷史報告）），2025年第四季，美國。
2 相較於Autotrader.com、Cars.com、TrueCar.com與CARFAX.com（Joreca截至2025年12月31日）

2025年8月6日，我們董事會在考量所有合理可得之選項與更廣泛之戰略重新評估後，決定對股東而言，風雨兼程CarOffer，包括CarOffer交易業務，是最符合股東利益之選擇。在更廣泛之戰略重新評估後，我們認為CarOffer交易業務在當前更波動且難預測之定價環境中，已證明較為低效，經銷商需要更多靈活性與廣泛自動化以簡化履行流程，而此模式無法提供。在風雨兼程後，我們將持續透過我們之洞察平台提供AI驅動之存貨智慧，並透過Sell My Car實現消費者車輛大規模來源，並專注於技術與分析，以實現更智慧之來源與定價決策，而非協助進行交易本身。
CarOffer 的風化作業已完成，並於 2025 年 12 月 31 日被視為已放棄營運，就會計用途而言。我們在所有期間的合併財務報表中，將 CarOffer 的財務結果列為已終止營運，除了合併綜合損益表、合併可贖回非控制權益及股東權益表，以及合併現金流量表。這些財務報表未經重新分類，且已終止營運包含於所有期間的各項報表中。
由於風化作業，我們產生總支出 13.3 百萬美元，其中所有現金支出均已支付。
如需進一步資訊，請參閱本年度報告其他處所附的合併財務報表附註 3。

自 2025 年第四季起，因應 CarOffer 的風化作業，本公司董事長（兼任 CODM）開始根據合併結果管理本公司業務、做出營運決策，並評估營運績效。因此，此變動導致定期提供給 CODM 並用以決策的資訊性質與內容有所調整，並使我們的報表結果與持續成長策略一致。因此，自 2025 年第四季起，我們將財務結果列為單一應報告分部。如需進一步的分部報表及地理資訊，請參閱本年度報告其他處所附的合併財務報表附註 14。
我們的營業收入來自 (i) 資訊商訂閱費，(ii) 自動車製造商及其他品牌廣告商的廣告收入，以及 (iii) 與融資服務公司合作。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度，我們產生營業收入 907.0 百萬美元，較截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度的 798.0 百萬美元增加 14%。

與本公司業務與產業相關的風險
• 本公司業務嚴重依賴與經銷商的關係。若大量經銷商終止與我們的訂閱契約，且/或經銷商關閉或合併導致我們產品需求減少，將對本公司業務與財務結果造成重大且不利的影響。
